policies.title: Azerbaijani ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa at port of entry
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule places Azerbaijan in its Port of Entry visa category.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Azerbaijani passport holder visiting Grenada; the schedule defines 'Port of Entry' as a visa granted on arrival in Grenada.
The Embassy's live visitor page confirms requirements depend on citizenship; work, study, residence, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment remain outside scope.
Admission remains subject to Grenada immigration control, carrier checks and the port-of-entry officer's requirements.

policies.title: Azerbaijani ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule names Azerbaijan in the authorized-visa cohort, requiring advance consular processing unless a separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Azerbaijani passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate valid third-country visa or residence waiver.
The Embassy requires an authorized-visa applicant to appear in person at the consulate before travel; approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, special documents, consular-jurisdiction requirements and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on document verification and completion.
steps: Determine that Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Appear in person and submit the listed authorized-visa documents to the competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
Do not finalize travel arrangements until the visa has been granted.

policies.title: Azerbaijani ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table expressly identifies Azerbaijan as eligible to obtain a visitor visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Azerbaijani passport holder travelling to Jordan as a short visitor.
The official table says the visa can be obtained upon arrival and states a 40 JOD total charge.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier checks, border-crossing limits and final admission remain outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback says visa-free, while Grenada's active Embassy-linked schedule names Azerbaijan under Port of Entry, defined as visa granted on arrival.
